transformations: Select ne_id, ASCII place name, admin-0 name, coordinates and pop_max from the official 1:50m simple GeoJSON distribution
Sort records by Natural Earth id and encode them as compact tuples
Load the derived asset only while the Other Side mode is active
missingValuePolicy: Missing population estimates remain null; place name and coordinates are required and records are not inferred.
boundaryPolicy: Nearest means nearest among the 1:50m Natural Earth selection, which favors regional significance and is not an exhaustive settlement index.
